_comment: Eval fixture (server/evals/checks): a React + TypeScript (Vite) shop project with a shared src/utils.ts, in the shape of demo/cache/lessons/516197461c0dacf3.json. Only the steps the cases use.

lesson.title: Shared helpers in a React + TypeScript app

steps.title: Use formatPrice in the cart
steps.instructions: In src/components/Cart.tsx, import formatPrice from ../utils and show each price as {formatPrice(item.price)}.

targets.caption: Import the helper at the top of Cart.tsx

hints: Named exports are imported with curly braces.
common_mistakes: import formatPrice from '../utils' (no braces) for a named export.

steps.title: Build for production
steps.instructions: In the terminal, run npm run build. It type-checks with tsc, then Vite writes the dist/ folder.
hints: A type error stops the build before Vite runs.
common_mistakes: Reading the output of an earlier build.

steps.title: Run the unit tests
steps.instructions: Run npm test. Jest runs src/utils.test.ts; every test should pass.
hints: A ✕ next to a test name is a failing test.
common_mistakes: Stopping at the first green line when another test failed.
